load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational, experimental, and XRD data files for CO2R or HER electrocatalysis analysis
get_production_rate: convert a Faradaic efficiency percentage and current density into a production rate in mol per cm squared per second
get_distance_between_formulas: compute the Euclidean distance between two chemical composition strings like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5 and Pt-0.6-Pd-0.4
get_constant_V: interpolate experimental electrocatalysis data to a fixed applied potential using log-space interpolation for Faradaic efficiency columns
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation category columns to a pandas DataFrame for ML training
